description: Exposure to ionizing radiation during military service in various capacities

eligibleExposures.description: Participated in atmospheric nuclear weapons testing
locations: Pacific Proving Grounds (Bikini Atoll, Enewetak Atoll)

eligibleExposures.description: Served in Hiroshima or Nagasaki, Japan
eligibleExposures.details: Within certain time periods after atomic bombings

eligibleExposures.description: Prisoners of war in Japan during WWII who were near Hiroshima or Nagasaki
Participated in underground nuclear weapons testing at Amchitka Island, Alaska
Participated in cleanup of Enewetak Atoll (1977-1980)
Worked in or near nuclear reactors while on active duty including cleanup of reactor incidents
Served as X-ray technician in active-duty military service

presumptiveCancers.description: Cancer of the colon or large intestine
Primary cancer of the liver (hepatocellular carcinoma)
Cancer of plasma cells in bone marrow

presumptiveCancers.condition: Urinary Tract Cancer (kidney, renal pelvis, ureter, bladder, urethra)

presumptiveCancers.note: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia is NOT presumptive

timeLimits.default: No time limit for most cancers

exceptions.onset: Must appear more than 1 year after radiation exposure
Can appear anytime, including within first year
Must appear more than 2 years after exposure
Must appear more than 5 years after first exposure

evidenceRequirements.serviceConnection: Presumptive IF radiation dose established to be positive OR participated in qualifying radiation-risk activity

radiationDose.requirement: VA will work with DoD to establish radiation dose
radiationDose.calculation: Dose reconstruction may be performed for certain exposures
radiationDose.threshold: Any positive dose can qualify for presumption

evidenceRequirements.medicalEvidence: Current diagnosis of qualifying cancer required
evidenceRequirements.serviceRecords: Documentation of participation in radiation-risk activity

doseReconstruction.description: VA may request dose reconstruction from Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA)
doseReconstruction.purpose: Estimate radiation dose received during service
doseReconstruction.process: Veteran or VA can request dose reconstruction; DTRA provides estimate

specialConsiderations.chronicLymphocyticLeukemia: NOT presumptive for radiation exposure - must prove direct service connection
specialConsiderations.metastaticCancer: Primary site determines presumption, not metastatic sites
specialConsiderations.multipleExposures: Veteran may have multiple qualifying radiation exposures
specialConsiderations.latencyPeriods: Different cancers have different minimum latency periods
specialConsiderations.dosageThreshold: Any positive radiation dose can establish presumption if cancer appears after appropriate latency period

references: M21-1, Part IV, Subpart ii, Chapter 2, Section F

atomicVeteransProgram.description: Special program for veterans exposed to ionizing radiation
benefits: Priority for VA health care enrollment (Priority Group 6)
Presumptive service connection for qualifying cancers
Free genetic counseling and testing for certain conditions
atomicVeteransProgram.contact: Call 1-800-827-1000 and ask for the Radiation Coordinator
